slides.title: Claude can animate now.
slides.sub: Claude Motion launched in beta on 8 Oct. What it does, who gets it, and the open-source route.

slides.title: Prompt in. MP4 out.
slides.body: Claude writes code that animates your **text, charts, shapes and images**. Change any word, number or timing in the editor or by asking, then download an MP4.
slides.quote: It doesn’t use a video generation model, so there’s no generated footage and no AI-generated people.

slides.title: Explaining your own work.
slides.body: Anthropic’s examples: a quarterly report as a 30‑second explainer, motion on a chart in a board deck, a product walkthrough for onboarding.
slides.close: Finished pieces open in **Adobe, Descript, HeyGen, Higgsfield, invideo, Luma AI or Runway**. Canva and Captions are coming soon.

slides.title: Team and Enterprise only.
slides.body: It’s a beta on **Team** (on by default) and **Enterprise** (off until an admin turns it on in Organization settings › Artifacts). Free, Pro and Max aren’t listed.
slides.close: Longer, more complex animations use more of your usage limit.

slides.title: Claude Design is on Free now.
slides.body: Docs, Slides and Design left beta and are on **every plan, including Free**. People have made more than 45 million docs, decks and designs.
slides.close: New: PowerPoint and PDF exports, sharing outside your organization, editing in the phone app.

slides.name: HyperFrames
slides.what: The same idea inside Claude Code: Claude writes HTML, HyperFrames renders it to **MP4**. It ships 21 skills and **210 ready animation blocks**.
slides.use: Motion on Pro or Max, with full control.
slides.install_label: Install in your terminal (needs Claude Code)

slides.title: Editable beats generated.
slides.body: Motion built from code keeps your exact words, numbers and brand. Change one and render again. For brand work, that’s the whole point.
slides.note: Sources: Anthropic on claude.com (8 Oct 2026) and HeyGen on GitHub.
slides.cta: Save this for your next build.
